sentences.en: I just love to read the agony column in teenage magazines.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢读青少年杂志上的倾诉专栏。

sentences.en: The matrix consisted of five rows and seven columns.
Caryatids are sculpted female figures that serve as columns.
sentences.zh: Caryatids 是用雕塑女性形象作为支撑柱的装饰。

senses.zh: 圆柱，纪念柱；柱状物；纵队，纵行（列）；（报纸、杂志上的）栏；（报纸或杂志的）专栏（文章）
